otaru-aquarium.name: Otaru Aquarium
otaru-aquarium.approx_cost: Winter season: ¥1,300 adults (high school and up), ¥500 children (one listing); summer price not confirmed

closed.irregular: Closed between seasons: Nov 24-Dec 11, 2026; also closed after the winter season ends (Feb 23, 2027) until the spring season, date not confirmed

otaru-aquarium.best_season: Spring to autumn for the full season; reduced winter season mid-Dec to late Feb

otaru-canal.name: Otaru Canal
otaru-canal.hours: Open-air promenade; gas lamps lit in the evening
otaru-canal.best_season: Winter evenings, especially during the Snow Light Path festival (early February)

otaru-city-museum.name: Otaru City Museum (Canal Building and Railway Museum)
otaru-city-museum.approx_cost: Canal Building ¥300; Railway Museum ¥400 (¥300 in winter); combined ¥600

closed.irregular: Railway Museum (main building) also closed Tuesdays, or the following day if Tuesday is a national holiday

otaru-herring-mansion.hours: 9:00-17:00 (until 16:00 from mid October to late November)

otaru-nikka-yoichi-distillery.approx_cost: Free (tasting included at the end of the tour)

otaru-sakaimachi-street.name: Sakaimachi Street
otaru-sakaimachi-street.approx_cost: Street free; Music Box Museum free; Museum of Venetian Art ¥700; Bank of Japan museum free; glass-making workshops typically ¥2,000-3,000
otaru-sakaimachi-street.hours: Shops roughly daytime. Music Box Museum 9:00-18:00 (until 19:00 Fri-Sat in summer), no closing days. Bank of Japan Otaru museum 9:30-17:00 (from 10:00 Dec-Mar), closed Wednesdays (open if a national holiday) and Dec 29-Jan 5.
otaru-sakaimachi-street.address_local: 〒047-8609 北海道地方北海道後志総合振興局小樽市港町色内一丁目日銀通り

otaru-snow-light-path.name: Otaru Snow Light Path
otaru-snow-light-path.recurrence: yearly, early February (8 days, usually overlapping the Sapporo Snow Festival)

editions.note: Main venues lit 17:00-21:00: Canal, Temiyasen (old railway path), Otaru Art Base and Tenguyama (upper ropeway station)

otaru-snow-light-path.approx_cost: Free (Tenguyama Ropeway ¥2,000 round trip for the hilltop venue)

otaru-tenguyama-ropeway.name: Mount Tenguyama Ropeway
otaru-tenguyama-ropeway.approx_cost: ¥2,000 round trip (winter fare as listed for 2027 Snow Light Path; other listings show ¥1,600-1,800 for older/summer fares)
otaru-tenguyama-ropeway.hours: Listed as 9:00-21:00 in summer and 9:00-20:00 in winter (last ascent 12 min before closing); not confirmed on the official site

closed.irregular: Maintenance stoppages in parts of April and November (around late Mar-mid Apr and early-late Nov); stops in bad weather

otaru-tenguyama-ropeway.best_season: All year; winter night views and the Snow Light Path venue at the top in February
otaru-tenguyama-ropeway.name_local: 小樽天狗山ロープウエイ

sapporo-to-otaru.name: Sapporo ↔ Otaru
sapporo-to-otaru.approx_cost: JR Rapid Airport Sapporo→Otaru about 32–36 min, ¥800 (child ¥400); about every 20 min in the daytime.
